dependencies.instrument: Law No. 369282 on entry and residence of EU, EEA and Swiss citizens and their family members

depends_on.relationship: The Latvian Act includes an informative reference to the Directive and implements the free-movement route.
The Act’s transitional paragraph applies Regulation 675 to applications submitted before 10 July 2026.
depends_on.status: scope unresolved for applications submitted on or after 10 July 2026; the official regulation record displays an end-of-validity date of 2 December 2027

depends_on.instrument: Cabinet regulations required by the 2026 Act
depends_on.relationship: The Act directs the Cabinet to issue rules for Sections 17, 19(1), 23(1), and 38(5) by 1 December 2027.
depends_on.status: check whether implementing rules have been issued before relying on operational steps; current procedural coverage remains incomplete

depends_on.instrument: Law on legal cooperation and protection of persons during the UK withdrawal transition
depends_on.relationship: The Act extends its route to UK nationals and family members who qualify under the Withdrawal Agreement implementation law.
depends_on.status: beneficiary and family procedures require a separate currentness review

depends_on.relationship: The Act is in force from 15 September 2026, while some sections are scheduled to take effect on 31 December 2027.
depends_on.status: use the currently effective edition and identify future-effective provisions separately; third-country immigration remains distinct from EU/EEA free movement

depends_on.relationship: General procedure and review may interact with Immigration Law decisions; the applicable remedy depends on the specific decision and statutory route.
depends_on.status: decision-specific remedy and deadline crosswalk remains open

depends_on.relationship: The general administrative procedure framework must be read with the applicable special-law decision, deadline and remedy provisions.
depends_on.status: general current text accepted as a reference; no full decision-type crosswalk is complete

depends_on.relationship: Public-record access and access by a party to its own administrative file are separate routes.
depends_on.status: distinction recorded; procedural mapping remains open

depends_on.instrument: Court Administration legal-aid guidance and forms
depends_on.relationship: Agency information explains application routes and selected proceedings; eligibility derives from law and the particular proceeding.
depends_on.status: official pages accepted as references; coverage of immigration and administrative proceedings remains unresolved

dependencies.instrument: Personal Data Processing Law and GDPR

depends_on.instrument: Data State Inspectorate complaint route and forms
depends_on.relationship: The DVI route is relevant to complaints about personal-data processing; the public complaint page still needs direct currentness review.
depends_on.status: forms index accepted; complaint procedure pending live review

dependencies.instrument: Rules on publishing court information online and processing court decisions before release

depends_on.instrument: E-lieta, Supreme Court and Constitutional Court decision repositories
depends_on.relationship: Publication rules and anonymisation determine which court decisions can be discovered in each official repository.
depends_on.status: official repositories identified; search completeness, historical coverage and repeatable discovery remain unverified

dependencies.instrument: Cabinet Regulation No. 536 and Latvijas Vēstnesis reuse terms

depends_on.instrument: Publisher confirmation for recurring retained copies
depends_on.relationship: The regulation and publisher process concern reuse, fees and supported recurring delivery, not whether a human-reviewed public official link can be cited.
depends_on.status: ordinary source links are usable; no recurring mirror is proposed; any future retained-copy workflow needs publisher-specific confirmation

dependencies.instrument: Declaration of Place of Residence Act

depends_on.instrument: Law No. 369282 on EU, EEA and Swiss citizens and family members
depends_on.relationship: Address declaration is an auxiliary administrative duty that follows residence facts; it does not establish the underlying free-movement residence entitlement.
depends_on.status: current consolidated link accepted; map the declaration process to the free-movement route and competent municipal/PMLP practice

depends_on.instrument: Law on the Register of Natural Persons (`lv-51`)
depends_on.relationship: The declaration process feeds residence-address information into the population register.
depends_on.status: current consolidated link accepted; data and administrative practice remain to be mapped

dependencies.instrument: Law on the Register of Natural Persons

depends_on.instrument: Law No. 369282 on EU, EEA and Swiss citizens and family members
depends_on.relationship: Register inclusion references foreigners holding or applying for specified EU registration and permanent-residence documents.
depends_on.status: current edition from 29 April 2026 accepted as a link; the register law does not itself grant residence rights

depends_on.relationship: Population-register processing and access interact with national data-protection law and GDPR.
depends_on.status: privacy rights and remedies require separate issue-level mapping

depends_on.relationship: Section 4(3) refers refusal appeals to the general administrative-procedure framework.
depends_on.status: current source link accepted; map the remedy and deadline to the specific registration decision

depends_on.instrument: Law No. 369282 on EU, EEA and Swiss citizens and family members
depends_on.relationship: Civil-status records may be used as family evidence in residence matters, but marriage-registration rules do not resolve all residence-document requirements.
depends_on.status: relationship noted; translation, public-document circulation and residence-specific evidence rules remain open
